output.research_goal: Research the subject “Ring of Nestor” and write a clear, concise, neutral, broadly scoped Wikipedia-style article supported by reliable published sources and numbered citations.

objectives.description: Produce a self-contained, encyclopedic article about “Ring of Nestor” that identifies the subject and covers the main aspects supported by reliable published sources, with a neutral lead, appropriate organization, balanced treatment, and numbered citations with a corresponding References section.
acceptance_criteria: The subject is identified using reliable published sources.
The article’s major factual claims are supported by numbered citations.
The presentation is neutral, clear, concise, and understandable to a broad audience.
The article includes a self-contained lead and a corresponding References section with full source URLs.
No Wikipedia page, including the prohibited URL, is used as a source.
Use reliable sources to confirm the identity of “Ring of Nestor.”
Identify any naming ambiguity or alternate terminology affecting subsequent searches.
Obtain canonical terminology and an initial reliable source set for planning further research.

runtime_validation.method: MemoryManager.init_research with the real planner output and in-memory graph adapters
